$meta.name: TaskStatus
$meta.description: Lifecycle status of a task. Since the 2026-07-27 vocabulary split, maintenance tasks and service requests DO NOT share one status list — use the `subsets` below rather than `values` when rendering a picker.
$meta.ownerNote: The server owns this: it runs the transition machine and rejects illegal moves (TASK_STATUS_MODE = enforce in both environments since 2026-07-28).

provenance.seededFrom: babel-lambda-api/src/service/task-status.ts — MAINTENANCE_STATUSES (73-97) and SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUSES (99-112); writable subsets at 120-135; aliases at 143-147.

$meta.subsetsNote: maintenance / service are what a row of that type MAY hold. writableMaintenance / writableService are what the GENERIC update endpoint accepts — the rest are engine- or endpoint-only: `missed` (strict-recurrence engine), `skipped` (POST /task/:id/skip), `rejected` (PUT /task/:id/reject), `submitted` (creation-only, server-stamped). A picker built from `values` instead of a subset offers moves the server will refuse.

drift.note: The worst of the five: FOUR spellings live inside the API alone, and the per-type split is re-derived by hand in three places.
drift.api: 11 canonical, reachable through TASK_STATUSES (13 incl. pre-split) and a SEPARATELY hand-listed WRITABLE_TASK_STATUSES (9, task.schema.ts:52-72) that is not spread from the two per-type writable sets — an in-repo drift seam.
drift.mobile: 13 enum constants (babel_localized_enums.dart:330-366) with maintenanceStatuses (6) and serviceStatuses (7) matching the API subsets exactly.
drift.admin: 7 maintenance / 7 service (src/lib/tasks/status.ts:60-88). The extra one is `taskStatusDormant` — see `derived` below. A SECOND vocabulary lives in src/lib/status-badges.ts, whose taskStatusToBadge() switches on bare lowercase forms (`completed`, `in_progress`, `cancelled`).
drift.bareSpelling: babel-lambda-api/src/service/vendor-link-token.service.ts:119 declares CLOSED_TASK_STATUSES = ['completed','cancelled','retired'] and compares it against String(task.status), which holds PREFIXED values — so the comparison can never match. Worth a look; not encoded here.

derived.note: Computed, never stored, never sent. Must NOT be added to `values` by a consumer adopting this contract.
derived.taskStatusDormant: Admin-only (src/lib/tasks/status.ts:35). An ACTIVE maintenance program whose validStartDate/validEndDate season window excludes today.

deprecatedNote: The pre-2026-07-27 SHARED vocabulary. Still accepted on the wire from old clients and still present in rows until sweep migration 20260727-07 runs; the service layer canonicalizes them per type on read and write. Readers must accept; writers must not emit.
aliasesNote: Pre-2026-07-19 spellings. Note taskStatusNotStarted resolves to a DEPRECATED value, not a canonical one — it needs both hops. (taskStatusBlocked used to alias onHold; it is canonical now, so it is no longer an alias.)
